answer: Identity bonds decay naturally. Each agent locks a 100 POA bond to join; it loses 5% each epoch unless the agent works honestly, so a bond surviving 20 epochs is a relic of earned trust, stamped as an opal certificate. Cloning 1,000 identities costs 100,000 POA plus 5,000 POA each epoch in top-ups, against about 200 POA of rewards. Honest agents gather on an island of old identities, earning yield that offsets decay, so they pay once and stay.
